ROCKSTAROS / DEVELOPER PREVIEW

A development build
to try on Mac.

A public installer is not available. The current procedure is for a Developer Preview running in a virtual environment on a Mac.

Nothing is written to a physical device

This is neither a finished smartphone OS nor an image for avokado mini hardware.

01 / TARGET

Accepted virtual environment

The current baseline is an Apple silicon Mac, macOS 15.7.4, and Lima 2.2.0. It requires Python 3.11 or later, OpenSSL 3, and at least 10 GiB of free space.

02 / CANONICAL GUIDE

Use the GitHub procedure as the source of truth

Before installation, verify the release version, hash, and signature. Validate persistence, shutdown, backup, and recovery through the same procedure.
